scope: Screen newly surfaced 3D authoring and browser SAT/SAB routes for an implementation-ready, reproducible peer that closes a named DWG/DXF/ACIS evidence gap.

method.kind: Public project README, supported-format table, and product-page review
method.limitations: This is a public-source scope screen, not a source audit or runtime qualification. Product-page claims for the Innerscene reader were not reproduced, and the reviewed page exposed no immutable parser artifact or machine-readable semantic report.

evidence.observed: The README describes a MIT-licensed procedural CAD authoring tool with OpenCascade B-rep operations and DXF export for visualization. It does not document DWG/DXF input or SAT/SAB import/export.
doesNotEstablish: an ACIS SAT/SAB reader or writer
an independent kernel vote from FreeCAD/OCCT
evidence.planDisposition: Exclude from the parser, writer, and consumer comparator set. Locally authored analytic inputs remain the clearer expected-value source; a model authored with yapCAD would not itself qualify file-format or ACIS behavior.

evidence.observed: The project overview makes a broad file-format claim, while its detailed supported-format table marks ACIS SAT/SAB read and write as planned/unchecked. This recheck agrees with the existing route audit.
evidence.planDisposition: Keep the existing exclusion; do not infer support from the headline format count or roadmap.

evidence.observed: The public product page claims a browser-local ACIS reader for SAT/SAB and Autodesk ASM, with body placement, units, curved surfaces, and measurement. The reviewed page exposed no source repository, immutable parser artifact/build identity, or machine-readable topology/loss/diagnostic report. It describes STEP output as faceted.
doesNotEstablish: DWG AcDs extraction or source-entity association
evidence.planDisposition: DISCOVERY_ONLY / NOT_RUN; exclude from the open-source peer set and do not send private drawings to the service. Any future black-box evaluation requires separate user authorization, local-processing verification, exact input/output hashes, and a predeclared measurable result.

nextActions: Apply the existing peer-admission stop rule: require the exact implemented operation/profile, a pin-able source/artifact and license route, and an independently measurable uncovered stage.
If any admission check fails, record DISCOVERY_ONLY and return to the existing implementation queue.
Keep peer runtimes out of per-slice validation and retain the existing single composed AcDs/SAB/semantic checkpoint.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
